description: She wears a floor-length cream underdress with a fitted deep blue overdress edged in gold geometric trim, broad shoulder straps held by round oval brooches, a decorated waist belt and low square neckline. Cream and blue sleeves gather at the forearms, with long fringed side drapes. A small pendant and wrist cuff are visible; brown leather shoes show beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
